title: Vally VS Code executor debug profile

name.description: Run name used for the stimulus and the run folder. Defaults to the profile file name.

prompt.description: Instruction sent to GitHub Copilot Chat.

model.description: Model name exactly as shown in the Copilot Chat model picker. Must be pinned. Omit to keep the current model.

extensions.description: Extension IDs to enable for the trial workspace. All others are disabled. Requires sqlite3 on PATH.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers merged into the trial workspace's .vscode/mcp.json.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the launched VS Code process.

workspace.description: Fixture folder copied into a fresh trial workspace. Relative to this profile file. Omit for an empty workspace.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for Copilot to finish. Defaults to 60 minutes to leave room for stepping through code.

devProxy.description: Capture traffic with Dev Proxy. Defaults to enabled when a certificate is available via devProxyPem or DEV_PROXY_PEM.

devProxyPem.description: Path to the Dev Proxy root certificate (PEM). Relative to this profile file. Overrides DEV_PROXY_PEM.

executablePath.description: Path to a nonstandard stable VS Code executable.

userDataPath.description: Path to the stable VS Code User directory.
